name_zh: 哈维尔/捷克/天鹅绒/异见/监狱/总统/剧作家/真理/生活在真理中
description_zh: 瓦茨拉夫·哈维尔（1936-2011），捷克剧作家、政治家，反极权主义领导者，天鹅绒革命领导者，任第一任总统。
description_en: Vaclav Havel (1936-2011), Czech playwright, politician, anti-totalitarian leader, Velvet Revolution leader, served as first President.
reason_zh: 哈维尔是后极权主义转型领导者，其剧作和政治实践对后极权主义转型产生深远影响。
reason_en: Havel was post-totalitarian transformation leader, his plays and political practice profoundly influenced post-totalitarian transformation.
